result.summary: Found 3 issues related to content truncation and layout in a food delivery app interface.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal carousel card is fully visible or add proper text truncation with ellipsis handling; the card appears clipped rather than intentionally partially shown.

issues.description: The category filter chips (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) appear to have an additional item partially cut off at the right edge, indicating a scrollable row but the truncation looks abrupt.
issues.suggestion: Add a visual fade or gradient indicator at the right edge to clearly signal the row is horizontally scrollable.

issues.description: The pizza card at the bottom shows a '-0%' discount badge, which is a meaningless/zero discount value.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is 0%, or verify the promotional data is being populated correctly.
